I've successfully updated the customInstructions for all three coder roles (Full Stack, Backend, and Frontend) to explicitly instruct them not to include diff markers or similar text in their code edits.

For each role, I added a new instruction (numbered as the last item in their respective lists) that states:

"When editing code, NEVER include diff markers (like ':start_line:40' or '-------') or any other non-code text in your edits. Only include the actual code changes."

This clear instruction should prevent the AI from leaving diff-type text in the code when it makes edits. The instruction specifically mentions the problematic patterns you identified (':start_line:40' and '-------') and emphasizes that only the actual code changes should be included.

These changes should help ensure that when the frontend-coder mode (or any other coder mode) edits code, it will only include the actual code changes without any diff markers or other non-code text.
